biological_event.recovery: drug washout followed by 1 h or 6 h recovery
biological_event.whole_event: transcriptomic displacement during acute mitochondrial uncoupling followed by recovery after CCCP removal
biological_event.target_observable_power: direct longitudinal state series with biological triplicates at untreated, damaged, 1 h washout, and 6 h washout states

construction_order: whole transcriptomic recovery event -> minimum state representation -> scalar only if independently licensed
source_qualification_rules: NCBI GEO accession and all 12 frozen GSM identities must resolve
processed expression source must be obtainable without substituting a different study or inferred sample mapping
all source files used for analysis must be hashed before expression values are inspected
raw-read reprocessing is not required if a source-deposited gene-level processed matrix is available and sample identity is explicit
if only raw reads are available, the analysis gate remains unopened until a frozen processing pipeline is specified

future_analysis_not_yet_opened.Bio_Chi: whether state displacement after CCCP moves back toward untreated transcriptomic organization after washout
future_analysis_not_yet_opened.Chi_bio: minimum multicoordinate transcriptomic state representation needed to preserve damage and recovery
future_analysis_not_yet_opened.chi_bio: NOT_OPENED; no scalar is licensed from cross-sectional replicate expression alone

failure_rules: missing or ambiguous processed matrix is SOURCE_LIMITED rather than a negative biological result
sample-label mismatch is a source-identity failure
literature-described recovery cannot rescue a failed source reproduction
no gene/pathway subset may be selected after outcome inspection to manufacture recovery
claim_ceiling: independent-source qualification only until processed source identity and a prospective analysis contract are closed
